notes.title: Clean Sweep Small Bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed:

The prompt to start Mansion level 1 combat not reappearing after choosing to not start the combat

Mansion level 1 not allowing you to leave after completing combat



If you encounter more bugs, please report them in our discord server!

notes.title: Clean Sweep Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Clean Sweep Demo Update is Live!


Hey Sweepy Heads!



We've been working hard to bring you new features and content for the Clean Sweep Demo! Here's a list of everything we've added!

Leveling System

Main Story Level 1

Soap's First Event

Environment Interactions

New Music

A New Quest

New Dialogue

A Ton of Bug Fixes

and more!



Thank you to everyone who's played the game so far! We could not have done this without you. We hope that you enjoy the current and future Clean Sweep content!





There is a known bug where after completing the first level of the Main Story, you can't exit the Dining Room. If you find yourself unable to exit after Beau gives the okay to leave, use the home button on your cellphone to return to the entrance of the mansion and continue with your day. 

We're working hard to fix this and any other bugs you may encounter!



Make sure to join our Discord and follow us on our socials!
